Technician Supervisors are responsible for the supervision and support of their assigned direct reports. This position supervises Pharmacy Technicians in our Specialty Pharmacy Hub (SP Hub) and reports to the SP Hub Manager.
50% - Supervision of Operations and Staff

This Technician Supervisor is responsible for supervision of their direct reports which involves timecard activities, performance management, training, scheduling, conducting meetings with staff and others, and creating, maintaining and having oversight of daily operations and workflows. The individual in this role serves as the primary point of contact of staff that they supervise for any questions or concerns. In addition, this individual may be asked to support pharmacy duties during times of operational needs such as customer service (via telephone, electronic and in-person), prescription data entry, insurance adjudication and troubleshooting, processing prescription payments and more.
40% - Specialty Pharmacy Duties

Technician Supervisors in the SP Hub are responsible for leading team huddles and meetings, and are expected to have strong customer service, collaboration, and communication skills to support their staff. As a member of the Specialty Pharmacy management team, the Technician Supervisor helps to identify areas of improvement and develop solutions through integration of pharmacy resources. The individual has a responsibility to follow-up and remedy any incident reports for responsible areas. A Technician Supervisor helps staff with goals, and maintains, writes, and delivers annual performance evaluations. Additionally, this position is highly collaborative with direct reports, peers and other leaders and requires participation in meetings within pharmacy and stakeholders external to pharmacy. #CA-DS
10% - Participate in Educational Activities
Demonstrated compliance with all pharmacy laws, rules and regulations
Strong desire to learn and develop as a leader within the department
Strong verbal communication skills to explain information to staff, patients, care team members, and others
Working knowledge of and skill to apply practices, principles and techniques of patient care related to area of expertise
Ability to type and document in written format conversations and care provided to others

Written and oral communication skills to clearly and concisely provide information, explanations and instructions to, and to elicit information from others with varying levels of ability to understand, including individuals who are ill or distressed, or who may not speak English
Recent working knowledge of outpatient pharmacy dispensing and third-party billing
Ability to exercise discretion to ensure that patient confidentiality is maintained, and a professional, respectful clinic/department environment exists at all times

Problem-solving skills to independently recognize and define a problem and identify the resources available to help solve the problem, ability to independently create and implement viable solutions and follow through to ensure the problem is resolved
Ability to impart knowledge and develop the skills of students participating in training programs, as well as new hires and staff seeking additional opportunities
